The Scorecard API makes it easier to automate and enforce your dependency policies. Naveen is one of the key contributors to the Scorecard projects, in this article, he walks through how it works!

Written by

Naveen Srinivasan

September 8, 2022

These dependencies help development teams move fast and stay productive.

Is it updated often?

Whenever you consider bringing in a new dependency, wouldn't it be nice to get a score on its health and security? Enter OSSF [Scorecard](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard).

The [OpenSSF Scorecard](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard) is an automated tool that assesses several important heuristics ("checks") associated with software security and assigns each check a score of 0-10. These scores help understand specific areas to improve to strengthen the security posture of a dependency.

Some of these checks include:

Projects like [enoyproxy](https://github.com/envoyproxy/envoy), [tensorflow](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow), and [flutter](https://github.com/flutter/flutter) use Scorecard - showing they have security awareness (and good taste).

The scorecard project scans more than 1 million repositories every week. The scan results are stored in [BigQuery](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard#public-data).

## Why the Scorecard API is a big deal
### Our policy should address:
- How have they changed over time?
- What do they do?
- How do they affect security posture?
- How are they updated?
- How can you limit your exposure?

The full working example is available at [[https://github.com/naveensrinivasan/scorecard-api-demo](https://github.com/naveensrinivasan/scorecard-api-demo)](https://github.com/naveensrinivasan/scorecard-api-demo).

The Scorecard project makes it easier for you to measure and create policy around the health of the dependencies you use. The Scorecard API makes it easier to automate and enforce those policies. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to the [Scorecard Community](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard#connect-with-the-scorecards-community).
